rationale: These batches are the whole real-analysis category. Batch 2 explicitly requires pages from batches 4 and 5, so one Alpha can follow the multivariable-calculus chain through constant rank, surface integration, volumes, and oscillatory examples end to end.

label: b
rationale: These batches share classification-by-structure machinery: Galois subgroup correspondence and PID canonical forms, covering-space classification through fundamental groups and subgroups, and Beck comparison equivalences for monadic algebras. This also separates the largest batch from the other large mixed algebraic batch.

label: c
rationale: This is the residual forced after preserving the real-analysis and classification clusters. Batches 6 and 8 are analytic developments, while the mixed group/number-theory batch 1 has no dependency edge to any other batch; this placement therefore adds no cross-group edge and keeps the reading load balanced.
